properties.SqlCommand:
WITH ventes_docs AS (
    SELECT d.Id, d.Transaction_Id
    FROM Documents_SA d
    WHERE d.State = '1'
      AND d.DocumentType_Id IN ('1','4','5','6','7')
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM RelatedDocuments_SA r WHERE r.Document1_Id = d.Id)
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DocumentItem_SA i
                  WHERE i.Document_Id = d.Id
                    AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(i.ProductStock_Id)), '') IS NOT NULL)
),
ids AS (
    SELECT ISNULL(TRY_CAST(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(t.Company_Id)), '') AS INT), -1) AS Company_Id
    FROM ventes_docs v
    LEFT JOIN Transactions_SA t ON t.Id = v.Transaction_Id
    UNION SELECT -1
    UNION SELECT 2
    UNION SELECT TRY_CAST(c.Id AS INT)
          FROM CompaniesList_SA c
          JOIN Clients_SA cl ON LTRIM(RTRIM(cl.Code)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(c.Code))
)
SELECT i.Company_Id,
       CAST(CASE WHEN i.Company_Id = -1 THEN N'NON RENSEIGNE'
                 WHEN i.Company_Id = 2  THEN N'Client comptoir (anonyme)'
                 ELSE COALESCE(
                      NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(r.NomRep, CHARINDEX(NCHAR(8212), r.NomRep) + 1, 200))), ''),
                      NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(c.Name, '|', ''))), ''),
                      N'NON RENSEIGNE') END AS NVARCHAR(200)) AS Nom,
       CAST(CASE WHEN i.Company_Id = -1 THEN N'NON RENSEIGNE'
                 WHEN i.Company_Id = 2  THEN N'COMPTOIR_ANONYME'
                 WHEN r.NomRep LIKE N'%Client particulier%' THEN N'PARTICULIER'
                 WHEN r.NomRep LIKE N'%Laboratoire%'         THEN N'B2B - LABORATOIRE'
                 ELSE N'NON RENSEIGNE' END AS NVARCHAR(30)) AS TypeClient,
       CAST(CASE WHEN i.Company_Id IN (-1, 2) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS BIT) AS EstClientIdentifie
FROM ids i
LEFT JOIN CompaniesList_SA c  ON TRY_CAST(c.Id AS INT) = i.Company_Id
LEFT JOIN Clients_SA cl       ON LTRIM(RTRIM(cl.Code)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(c.Code))
CROSS APPLY (SELECT dbo.fn_reparer_accents(cl.Nom) AS NomRep) r
WHERE i.Company_Id IS NOT NULL;

properties.ReferenceMetadataXml: <referenceMetadata><referenceColumns><referenceColumn name="Fournisseur_Id" dataType="DT_I4" length="0" precision="0" scale="0" codePage="0"/><referenceColumn name="Nom" dataType="DT_WSTR" length="200" precision="0" scale="0" codePage="0"/></referenceColumns></referenceMetadata>

properties.SqlCommand:
WITH ids AS (
    SELECT TRY_CAST(c.Id AS INT) AS Fournisseur_Id
    FROM CompaniesList_SA c
    WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(c.CompanyType_Id)) = '2'
    UNION
    SELECT TRY_CAST(t.Company_Id AS INT)
    FROM Documents_SA d
    JOIN Transactions_SA t ON t.Id = d.Transaction_Id
    WHERE d.State = '1' AND d.DocumentType_Id IN ('20','23')
      AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(t.Company_Id)), '') IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT i.Fournisseur_Id,
       CAST(COALESCE(
            dbo.fn_reparer_accents(
  CASE WHEN f.Nom LIKE '[0-9]%. %'
       THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(f.Nom, CHARINDEX('. ', f.Nom) + 2, 200)))
       ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(f.Nom)) END),
            LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(c.Name, '|', ''))),
            N'FOURNISSEUR INCONNU ' + CAST(i.Fournisseur_Id AS NVARCHAR(10))
       ) AS NVARCHAR(200)) AS Nom
FROM ids i
LEFT JOIN CompaniesList_SA c ON TRY_CAST(c.Id AS INT) = i.Fournisseur_Id
LEFT JOIN Fournisseurs_SA   f ON LTRIM(RTRIM(f.Code)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(c.Code))
WHERE i.Fournisseur_Id IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT -1, N'NON RENSEIGNE';

properties.ReferenceMetadataXml: <referenceMetadata><referenceColumns><referenceColumn name="PaymentMode_Id" dataType="DT_I4" length="0" precision="0" scale="0" codePage="0"/><referenceColumn name="PaymentModeName" dataType="DT_WSTR" length="50" precision="0" scale="0" codePage="0"/></referenceColumns></referenceMetadata>

properties.SqlCommand:
SELECT DISTINCT
       TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(PaymentMode_Id)) AS INT) AS PaymentMode_Id,
       CASE LTRIM(RTRIM(PaymentMethodName))
            WHEN 'Core.PaymentMode.Cheque'       THEN N'Chèque'
            WHEN 'Core.PaymentMode.Cash.Tunisia' THEN N'Espèces'
            WHEN 'Core.PaymentMode.BankCard'     THEN N'Carte bancaire'
            WHEN 'Core.PaymentMode.Credit'       THEN N'Crédit (paiement différé)'
            WHEN 'Core.PaymentMode.Jetons'       THEN N'Jetons'
            ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(PaymentMethodName)) END AS PaymentModeName
FROM PaymentsList_SA
WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(PaymentMode_Id)), '') IS NOT NULL
UNION
SELECT -1, N'Non renseigné';
